ops.text: drive on a Sprite lane (~/.local/bin/drive) asks each verb as a blocking Orca question to the coordinator's Mac; on 2026-11-15 'drive --root' took over 10 minutes to come back and 'drive job set j5396 --repro' did not answer inside 600 s, so a lane following the brief's 600000 ms Bash timeout for drive verbs gets killed mid-wait and has to re-ask, which may run the verb twice on the Mac. The shim's 600 s WAIT_MS matches the brief's timeout exactly, so the resume loop never gets a turn; a worker should either get a longer documented timeout or the shim should return the messageId so a killed wait can resume it.
